subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw add a public skill configuration action to `SKILL.md`/`metadata.openclaw`, and what URL/button trust contract should the dashboard enforce?
rationale: The code change is straightforward, but the public metadata shape and URL trust behavior affect plugin/skill authors and dashboard security semantics.

options.title: Add typed config action
options.body: Define a typed configuration-action payload with validated URL policy, default label, docs, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Reuse existing surfaces
options.body: Keep using `homepage`, Skill Cards, or ClawHub package metadata instead of adding new frontmatter fields.

options.title: Defer core support
options.body: Leave configuration entry points to plugin/ClawHub package pages until maintainers want a broader settings-surface design.

recommendation.title: Add typed config action
recommendation.body: Define a typed configuration-action payload with validated URL policy, default label, docs, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans dashboard URL policy and public extension-surface direction, and recent history ties this owner to the shared UI URL helper.
